One "For You" request (numbered arrows), all over HTTPS

1Student signs in: Auth0 → Google → UW NetID + Duo. An Auth0 Action refuses non-UW accounts.
2The panel gets a short-lived access token (a signed JWT) from the app's own /auth/access-token route.
3Browser calls the API with the token. The backend checks the signature, expiry, audience and UW email itself.
4It reads only this user's clicks (one indexed query) and scores ~70 student events with hourly stats.
5Returns ranked events, each with a reason ("Because you liked Technology events").
The user is taken from the verified token, never from the request, so nobody can act as someone else.
DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT PIPELINE

GitHub repo

One PR per change
API contracts in api/
LLM eval set + results

GitHub Actions

ruff + pytest (202 tests)
ESLint + Next.js build
must pass before merging

Deploy on merge

Vercel builds the frontend
Render deploy hook, then CI polls /api/health
until the live version = the merged commit
